TOKEN.description: Skland login token for scheduled sign-ins. Get data.content from https://web-api.skland.com/account/info/hg. Separate multiple accounts with commas.

WORKER_AUTH.description: A separate random Bearer password for the manual trigger endpoint. Do not use your Skland token.

SC3_SENDKEY.description: Optional ServerChan3 SendKey. Leave empty if unused.

SC3_UID.description: Optional ServerChan3 UID. Usually safe to leave empty.

QMSG_KEY.description: Optional Qmsg key. Leave empty if unused.

PUSHPLUS_KEY.description: Optional PushPlus token. Leave empty if unused.
